title: Auditing the Judge: Human-Derived Bias Discovery, Quantification, and Mitigation in LLM Judges
abstract: arXiv:2611.33065v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as automated evaluators in evaluation and training pipelines, their judgements are often affected by systematic biases that conflict with human preferences. Although prior work has identified various biases and proposed methods for detecting and mitigating them, less attention has been paid to using human preferences to inform bias identification and mitigation. Moreover, these approaches rely heavily on pre-discovered bias lists, overlook bias strength, and depend on costly interventions. In this work, we propose HUB-J, an integrated framework based on human-derived bias factors that detects, quantifies, and mitigates biases in LLM-as-a-Judge systems. Our approach leverages human-LLM judgement disagreement cases to automatically discover interpretable bias factors, and utilizes agreement cases to quantify bias strength through controlled input modifications and resulting shift

translated_title: 审计评判者：基于人类发现的偏见在LLM评判系统中的发现、量化与缓解
translated_abstract: 虽然大语言模型越来越多地被部署为评估和训练流程中的自动化评估器，但其判断往往受到与人类偏好相冲突的系统性偏见的影响。尽管先前的研究已经识别出各种偏见并提出了检测和缓解方法，但对利用人类偏好来指导偏见识别与缓解的关注却较少。此外，这些方法严重依赖预先发现的偏见列表，忽视了偏见强度，并且依赖成本高昂的干预措施。在本工作中，我们提出了HUB-J，一个基于人类衍生偏见因子的集成框架，用于检测、量化和缓解LLM作为评判者系统中的偏见。我们的方法利用人类与LLM判断不一致的案例自动发现可解释的偏见因子，并利用一致的案例通过受控输入修改及其产生的偏移来量化偏见强度。
tldr: 该论文提出HUB-J集成框架，利用人类与LLM判断不一致的案例自动发现可解释的偏见因子，并通过受控输入修改量化偏见强度，实现LLM评判系统中偏见的发现、量化与缓解。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HUB-J, an integrated framework that automatically discovers interpretable bias factors from human-LLM judgment disagreements and quantifies bias strength through controlled input modifications, enabling detection, quantification, and mitigation of biases in LLM-as-a-Judge systems.
